title: ClearHead Transaction Request
description: A batch of semantic action operations that must validate together and commit together through one PendingBatch. Operations are applied in array order against trusted workspace state loaded under the workspace lock; any invalid operation rejects the whole batch before a write. This is NOT a JSON Patch or a desired-state document: each operation names an intent (update / complete / cancel) whose side effects (in-place field edits vs. cascade-close + date-stamp + file move) core owns. Single-item work should use the ordinary verbs; a transaction exists only for edits that must be atomic together. Dry-run is an invocation flag (`clearhead transact --dry-run`), not part of this document.

operations.description: Ordered operations. Applied in sequence; the batch is all-or-nothing.

canonicalId.description: Canonical action identity as a urn:uuid IRI, the exact spelling the query contract exports and the CLI resolver accepts.

updateAction.description: Edit an action's attributes in place (single file). No cascade, no move. State may be set to a NON-terminal value here; terminal transitions (completed / cancelled) are rejected by core in favor of the complete-action / cancel-action operations, which carry the cascade + date-stamp + file-move semantics a field write cannot.

set.description: Fields to change; mirrors core's ActionUpdate applier surface. At least one field. Dependency-graph edits (predecessors, is_sequential) are intentionally out of the v1 operation set.

context.description: Context tags as bare names (no leading '+'). Replaces the existing set.

state.description: Action state, serialized as core ActionState does (snake_case; BlockedOrAwaiting => 'blocked'). Terminal values 'completed'/'cancelled' are accepted structurally but rejected by core's in-place terminal-state guard — use complete-action / cancel-action instead.

completeAction.description: Close an action and its full open subtree as Completed: stamp completed_at, detach the closed root from any external parent, and move the subtree from the active file to the .completed.actions file. Runs core's close_subtree; not expressible as an update.

cancelAction.description: Close an action and its full open subtree as Cancelled, via the same close_subtree machinery as complete-action.
